values.meaning: Physical Damage Per Spin (base tick damage)
Damage Per Spin against the nearest enemy hit (the only target in a dummy fight is always the nearest) - equals base tick damage multiplied by 1.25
values.binNote: No bin row states 5/8.75/... or the 1.25x AD coefficients directly. The wiki computes this by multiplying GarenE#TotalDamage's base and AD-ratio components by the near-bonus multiplier (1 + GarenE.NearestEnemyBonus = 1.25), i.e. 4*1.25=5, 0.4*1.25=0.5, etc. These derived numbers are not present as standalone bin values; they are reconstructed from BaseDamagePerTick x 1.25 and ADRatioPerTick x 1.25 per the wiki's own {{#var:near}}=1.25 formula.

values.meaning: Number of spins (damage ticks), base + bonus from bonus attack speed
values.quote: '''Garen''' rapidly spins his sword around himself {{#var:spin_b}} (+ 1 per {{tt|{{as|{{#var:spin_as}}% '''bonus''' attack speed}}
values.binNote: GarenE.ASPerTick=0.25 is the bonus-AS fraction required per extra spin (1 extra spin per 25% bonus AS); the stated coef 4 = 1/0.25 expresses this as 'extra spins per 100% bonus AS' for the fight sim's convenience, not a separate bin row.

mechanics.claim: Each spin deals damage simultaneously to all enemies within its range when the spin is completed.
mechanics.quote: Each spin deals damage simultaneously to all enemies within its range when the spin is completed.

mechanics.claim: Judgment can be recast after 1 second while active, and does so automatically after it ends, meaning it cannot be extended past its base duration.
mechanics.quote: ''Judgment'' can be recast after 1 second while active, and does so automatically after it ends.

mechanics.claim: Armor reduction is applied on the 6th hit, then refreshes every 6th hit thereafter (7th, 13th, ...).
mechanics.quote: Enemy champions hit 6 times by ''Judgment'' are inflicted with {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|25% armor reduction}}}} for 6 seconds, with the duration refreshing upon the 7th hit and every 6th hit thereafter.

mechanics.claim: Judgment's extra-spin scaling only counts bonus attack speed from items and level growth, not other bonus attack speed sources (e.g. buffs) - relevant for determining tick count from a given build.
mechanics.quote: ''Judgment'' only scales with {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} from items and growth (per level).

mechanics.claim: The visible spin animation is capped at 200% bonus attack speed, but the number of damage ticks keeps scaling beyond that cap.
mechanics.quote: The spin animation is capped at {{as|{{tt|200%|Once per 0.2 seconds, 15 spins total}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}, but the amount of ticks will keep on scaling.

mechanics.claim: Garen cannot use basic attacks while spinning.
mechanics.quote: becoming {{tip|lockout|unable}} to declare basic attacks but gaining {{tip|ghosting}}

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown starts only after the spin sequence ends, not on cast.
Manually deactivating Judgment early does not count as an ability activation for on-cast effects (e.g. Spellblade), which matters for item interactions in a build fight.
mechanics.quote: Deactivating the ability manually does not count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
